description: Read how well Summer's own "run it" call matches what happened, per action and per action family (reply, closure, record, vendor_contact, clinician_note, address_cancel, money, other) over the last 14 and 30 days: plans proposing it, the agent's calls, what people did (approved unchanged, with direction, edited, another option, dismissed, superseded), auto-run decisions with each action's reason and deciding rule, the action's run results (completed, failed, unknown), checked results, daily closure audit verdicts and corrected quality assessments on those tickets. Each family and action has an error rate (person changes to plans the agent said to run, failed or unknown runs and failed audits, over decided plans) and a status: ready_to_widen (at least 30 decisions and under 1% errors in 14 days), keep, or tighten (over 5%). Families show the saved policy's kill switch or automatic rule. Categories show closed-without-a-person and audited-correct rates against the 95% and 98% targets, with the gap. Counts are recorded events, not verified customer outcomes. Calls no model and starts no work.
